userObservation: Revision 1.14 looks unstable and significantly worse.

addedProcessing: Optical-flow correspondence mesh forces distinct video poses into the illustrated idle endpoint.
Time-dependent idle deformation was applied to decoded video texture coordinates.
Native head rotation and shoulder drift were added as well.
sourceLimitations: The generated gesture endpoints do not match the original illustrated posture exactly.
The previously paid five-second source gestures were compressed into three-second files at 5/3 speed.
The available packed video-v3 files already include background matting, so this comparison is before/after endpoint deformation, not the untouched provider output.
diagnosis.earlierValidation: Schedule, alpha coverage and pixel changes did not establish natural anatomical motion. The v14 visual assessment was insufficient.

correction.videoAssets: Use the existing video-v3 files directly. Do not use living-v14 or the geometric preparation script.
correction.videoCoordinates: Fixed UV coordinates, no clock, breathing field, rotation or mesh transformation in the compositor.
correction.nativeIdle: Existing breathing, hair and cloth only, at 25% idle scale. No added head tilt, shoulder drift or separate eye donor.
correction.transition: Existing 640ms premultiplied blend. It retains source pose mismatch; this is not described as a seamless result.

verification.rtpGate: Independent module build enforced current RTP gate

serverWalletTests.note: First local port bind was denied by environment permissions; all eight passed with local network access.

browserTests.host: Full Royal host with connected chat, desktop/mobile, disposable local account
scenarios: Three distinct gestures, scheduling, rules, reduced motion, close
Native idle movement before/after a gesture, alpha coverage, pinned decoded video pixel stability
Unavailable video retains native renderer and playable controls
Choice, bonus, exact settlement, desktop/mobile and reopen

rendered.note: Fixed decoded frame and advancing application clock produce six identical full-pixel hashes. This verifies no added time-varying video motion, not subjective quality.

comparison.left: video-v3/focus, prior to geometric endpoint processing
comparison.method: RGB halves cropped from the existing packed videos, side-by-side, no further geometry transformation.

scope: Local correction, feature branch only, no production publication, no rule, wallet or catalogue change
remainingLimitations: Source pose mismatch is still visible at the handoff. A credible exact return needs suitable source motion with constrained start and end poses. This correction removes added deformation, it does not claim that remaining transitions or source motion are natural.
